content: Peer agent-native packaging (official docs/repos via search): qmd ships Claude Code plugin marketplace (claude plugin marketplace add tobi/qmd; claude plugin install qmd@qmd) AND skills/qmd/SKILL.md in repo (citation discipline: 'Output is line-numbered and carries the docid — cite both'); npm/bun -g @tobilu/qmd. basic-memory: uv tool install basic-memory; plugin >=0.19.0 needs --prerelease=allow (FastMCP prerelease); marketplace add basicmachines-co/basic-memory --sparse .claude-plugin plugins/claude-code; 8 skills (bm-setup/orient/remember/checkpoint/decide/status/share/writing) + SessionStart/PreCompact hooks with uvx fallback; generic skills npx skills add; hybrid search_notes default since v0.20.2 min_similarity 0.45. GNO: gno skill install --scope user (/gno search|query|ask|graph) + gno mcp install --target claude-code (both coexist); retrieval ladder incl. recall (8 facts <512 tokens) + context build --budget; Qwen3-Embedding/Reranker-0.6B. memsearch (Zilliz): uv tool install memsearch [onnx]; plugin marketplace zilliztech/memsearch; 3-layer memory; search -> expand <chunk_hash> -> parse-transcript; default ONNX bge-m3 ~558MB + Milvus Lite.
